mapper.sql: id, merchant_id, role_code, token_hash, status, invited_by_member_id, invited_at, expires_at, accepted_by_member_id, accepted_at, revoked_by_member_id, revoked_at, revoke_reason, request_id, version, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: select from merchant_operator_invite where token_hash = #{tokenHash} for update

select from merchant_operator_invite where accepted_by_member_id = #{acceptedByMemberId} and status = 'ACCEPTED' and token_hash = lower(sha2(concat(#{originalTokenHash}, ':consumed:', id), 256)) limit 1

select from merchant_operator_invite where accepted_by_member_id = #{acceptedByMemberId} and status = 'ACCEPTED' and token_hash = lower(sha2(concat(#{originalTokenHash}, ':consumed:', id), 256)) limit 1 for update
select from merchant_operator_invite where id = #{id} for update
select from merchant_operator_invite where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
select from merchant_operator_invite where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and request_id = #{requestId} for update
select from merchant_operator_invite where merchant_id = #{merchantId} order by id desc
mapper.insert: insert into merchant_operator_invite (merchant_id, role_code, token_hash, status, invited_by_member_id, invited_at, expires_at, request_id, version, create_time, update_time) values (#{merchantId}, #{roleCode}, #{tokenHash}, #{status}, #{invitedByMemberId}, #{invitedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{requestId}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update merchant_operator_invite set status = 'ACCEPTED', accepted_by_member_id = #{acceptedByMemberId}, accepted_at = now(), token_hash = lower(sha2(concat(token_hash, ':consumed:', id), 256)), version = version + 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING' and version = #{expectedVersion} and expires_at > now()

update merchant_operator_invite set status = 'REVOKED', revoked_by_member_id = #{revokedByMemberId}, revoked_at = now(), revoke_reason = #{revokeReason}, token_hash = lower(sha2(concat(token_hash, ':revoked:', id), 256)), version = version + 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and merchant_id = #{merchantId} and status = 'PENDING' and version = #{expectedVersion}

update merchant_operator_invite set status = 'EXPIRED', token_hash = lower(sha2(concat(token_hash, ':expired:', id), 256)), version = version + 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING' and version = #{expectedVersion} and expires_at <= now()

update merchant_operator_invite set status = 'REVOKED', revoked_by_member_id = null, revoked_at = now(), revoke_reason = #{revokeReason}, token_hash = lower(sha2(concat(token_hash, ':owner-changed:', id), 256)), version = version + 1, update_time = now() where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and status = 'PENDING'
